top_signals.title: Everything changed for the oil, AI and bond trades over the past month
top_signals.summary: The market expects oil to keep rising, but treasury yields have declined, a warning traders and investors may be more worried about an AI crash than inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Vinyl record bars and cafes, odd Halloween trick-or-treat offerings, the South Korean trend of being seen reading physical books, and Just Eats apologizing for AI mistake: Join hosts David Gura, Lisa Mateo and Nathan Hager on Bloomberg This Weekend for Bookmarked, where they share stories that caught their attention over the past week. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Azerbaijan’s Renewable Energy Boom Is Transforming Its Power Sector
top_signals.summary: Azerbaijan, long known as a major oil and gas power, has ventured into renewable energy in recent years and is rapidly ramping up its capacity. As host of COP29, Azerbaijan’s government announced an ambitious climate target and encouraged other governments to do the same.  Renewable energy contributed 20 per cent of Azerbaijan’s total electricity production in the first nine months of the year, an increase from 13.4 per cent in 2025, marking a significant achievement in capacity growth.
